g.title: scaler_edge_directed
g.text: splits the 2x2 cell along the stronger diagonal so interpolation never crosses an edge
1 output pixel per clock - 8 pipeline stages (A B W D C G M S) + output register
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: regbus
g.text: AW and W in any order, OKAY responses

g.title: ctrl
g.text: capture FSM: SOF / EOL checks, writes the

g.title: dda
g.text: exact accumulation, SOF / EOL / EOF flags
stalls with the pipeline (adv), hold for LINE_BUF

g.title: fb
g.text: 2 x 2 RAM banks (B = 2): a 2x2 window every clock

g.title: dp
g.text: 8 stages (A B W D C G M S) + output register
d1 + THRESH < d2 : split on p00-p11
d2 + THRESH < d1 : split on p01-p10
four integer weights for the chosen case
